day4_afternoon_start.name: Me
day4_afternoon_start.text: *We left the cafe and walked the streets together. The afternoon was already deepening.*

day4_walk_together.name: Me
day4_walk_together.text: *Walking side by side, taking in the surroundings. Weekend crowds everywhere. Laughter, music, sweet smells all blending together.*

day4_walk_street.name: Me
day4_walk_street.text: *Our reflection in a shop window. We looked like an actual couple -- my heart lurched.*

day4_walk_market.name: Me
day4_walk_market.text: *A small market tucked down a side alley. Delicious smells carried on the breeze.*

day4_walk_food_choice.name: Me
day4_walk_food_choice.text: *A street food stall caught my eye.*
choices: "Want to get one and split it?"
"That looks good... let's just browse a bit."

day4_walk_food_share.name: Me
day4_walk_food_share.text: *Bought a fish-shaped pastry and tore it in half. Warm steam rose up. "Here, your half." My hand trembled slightly as I held it out.*

day4_walk_food_look.name: Me
day4_walk_food_look.text: *Browsing in front of the stall, our shoulders brushed. Heart lurched. I played it cool, but my ears were burning.*

day4_walk_close.name: Me
day4_walk_close.text: *We walked side by side back onto the main road. The streets had quieted down, sunset light stretching long between the buildings.*

day4_walk_feelings.name: Me
day4_walk_feelings.text: *Just walking together can feel this good. I snuck a glance at the person beside me. An emotion I couldn't name was swelling up inside.*

day4_afternoon_walk.name: Me
day4_afternoon_walk.text: *Since when was walking side by side this nice? Every time our fingertips nearly touched, my pulse quickened.*

day4_special_notice.name: Me
day4_special_notice.text: *As we walked, some charming little shops appeared tucked in the alley. They pointed at one.*

day4_special_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_special_seoyeon.text: "Hold on. Flower shop right there. Let's go in."

day4_special_seoyeon_react.name: Me
day4_special_seoyeon_react.text: *Seoyeon picked a single bloom from among the flowers and held it out. "Here. The flower language is a secret."*

day4_special_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_special_yuna.text: "...Over there. Used bookstore. Can we stop in?"

day4_special_yuna_react.name: Me
day4_special_yuna_react.text: *Yuna carefully pulled a book from the old shelves. "This book... I wanted to read it with you." Her eyes shimmered softly.*
choices: "Let's read it together. One chapter a day."
"If you picked it, it's got to be good."

day4_special_dain.name: Dain
day4_special_dain.text: "OH!! A sports store!! Hang on, I need to check something!!"

day4_special_dain_react.name: Me
day4_special_dain_react.text: *Dain came running over holding matching wristbands. "Look at these, couple bands! Let's each get one!!" Her face was slightly flushed.*
choices: "You pick for us. You've got the eye for it."

day4_special_nurse.name: Nurse
day4_special_nurse.text: "Oh, an antique shop over there. Want to browse?"

day4_special_nurse_react.name: Me
day4_special_nurse_react.text: *She held a vintage brooch up to the sunlight. "Isn't this lovely? Something about it makes me want to keep it forever."*
choices: "It'd look great on you. Let me buy it for you."
"You've got great taste. It really is beautiful."

day4_special_teacher.name: Teacher
day4_special_teacher.text: "Hold on, can we stop by that stationery shop? I need a pen."

day4_special_teacher_react.name: Me
day4_special_teacher_react.text: *She was picking out a pen when she paused and grabbed another one. "...This one's yours. Take good notes in class. It's a gift." She turned away, but the tips of her ears were red.*
choices: "Thank you. I'll use it every day."
"It's extra special because you picked it."

day4_afternoon_special.name: Me
day4_afternoon_special.text: *A special moment. "Hey, want to check out the riverside park?" They suggested it first.*

day4_afternoon_park.name: Me
day4_afternoon_park.text: *We arrived at the riverside park. The sunset was sparkling across the water. Like a scene straight out of a movie.*

day4_sunset_approach.name: Me
day4_sunset_approach.text: *Walking slowly along the riverbank. Golden ripples shimmered across the water's surface. Time seemed to decelerate.*

day4_sunset_colors.name: Me
day4_sunset_colors.text: *The sky shifted from orange to pink to violet. I've never seen a sky like this before.*

day4_sunset_wind.name: Me
day4_sunset_wind.text: *A warm breeze brushed past. Wind carrying the scent of grass and water. The gentle murmur of the current played like background music.*

day4_sunset_stare_seoyeon.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon was leaning on the railing, gazing at the sunset. Her hair fluttering in the wind. Her profile bathed in that golden glow -- god, she's beautiful.*

day4_sunset_stare_yuna.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_yuna.text: *Yuna was quietly watching the sunset. Her usual blank expression had softened into something gentle. I've never seen this face before.*

day4_sunset_stare_dain.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_dain.text: *Dain let out a soft "Wow..." Unlike her usual boundless energy, she stood perfectly still watching the sunset. She looked unexpectedly grown-up.*

day4_sunset_stare_nurse.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_nurse.text: *She gazed at the sunset through half-closed eyes. Bathed in the afterglow, she looked like a painting come to life.*

day4_sunset_stare_teacher.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_teacher.text: *She leaned against the railing, looking down at the river. All trace of her usual strictness gone, replaced by a soft expression.*

day4_afternoon_sunset.name: Me
day4_afternoon_sunset.text: *The sunset was lighting up their face. Strangely, words wouldn't come.*

day4_afternoon_feeling.name: Me
day4_afternoon_feeling.text: *I know what this feeling is now. Since the first day I transferred here -- I've been feeling it all along.*

day4_confession_choice.name: Me
day4_confession_choice.text: *Right now, this moment... should I tell them how I feel?*
choices: "You know if you run, I'm coming after you. Just stay and hear me out."

day4_confess.name: Me
day4_confess.text: "The truth is, ever since I transferred... there's been one person on my mind every single day."

day4_confess_heartbeat.name: Me
day4_confess_heartbeat.text: *My heart was hammering. Thump, thump, thump. Can they hear this too?*

day4_confess_2.name: Me
day4_confess_2.text: "At first I thought you were just a good person. Now I'm certain it's more than that."

day4_confess_breathe.name: Me
day4_confess_breathe.text: *Deep breath in. Fists clenched. If not now -- I'll regret it for the rest of my life.*

day4_confess_silence.name: Me
day4_confess_silence.text: *The words ended and silence fell. The world drenched in sunset seemed to freeze. Every second stretched into an hour.*

day4_confess_to_seoyeon.name: Me
day4_confess_to_seoyeon.text: "Seoyeon. Every time you smile, my eyes lock on and won't let go. I can't pretend I don't notice anymore."

day4_confess_to_yuna.name: Me
day4_confess_to_yuna.text: "Yuna. The moment I saw the warmth hiding behind that indifferent look, my eyes have been on you ever since."

day4_confess_to_dain.name: Me
day4_confess_to_dain.text: "Dain. When you laugh, I can't help laughing too. At some point, everything feels empty when you're not around."

day4_confess_to_nurse.name: Me
day4_confess_to_nurse.text: "This isn't me speaking as a student. This is me speaking as a person. I like you."

day4_confess_to_teacher.name: Me
day4_confess_to_teacher.text: "When you're strict, when you smile -- I liked all of it. These feelings are genuine, and they're only for you."

day4_accept_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_accept_seoyeon.text: "...Me too. Since the first day you transferred. Remember? You're completely mine now."

day4_accept_seoyeon_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_seoyeon_moment.text: *Tears glistened at the corners of Seoyeon's eyes. Those tears sparkling in the sunset -- like the most beautiful jewels in the world.*

day4_accept_seoyeon_close.name: Seoyeon
day4_accept_seoyeon_close.text: "If you look at another girl... I'm seriously not letting that slide. Got it?" *Seoyeon laced her fingers through mine and squeezed tight.*

day4_accept_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_accept_yuna.text: "...Idiot. I was going to say it first."

day4_accept_yuna_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_yuna_moment.text: *Yuna ducked her head slightly. Red all the way to her ears. So completely unlike her usual self that my heart felt like it would burst.*

day4_accept_yuna_close.name: Yuna
day4_accept_yuna_close.text: "...Don't move." *Yuna gripped my sleeve tight and leaned her forehead against my shoulder.*

day4_accept_dain.name: Dain
day4_accept_dain.text: "Me too!! I like you too!! Oh my god!! ...For real?!"

day4_accept_dain_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_dain_moment.text: *Dain grabbed my arm with both hands. Her face was flushed bright red, but her eyes were absolutely sparkling.*

day4_accept_dain_close.name: Dain
day4_accept_dain_close.text: "We're officially together now, right?! Really?! My heart's gonna EXPLODE!!" *Dain bounced on her feet, grabbed my hand, and shook it wildly.*

day4_accept_nurse.name: Nurse
day4_accept_nurse.text: "I knew... I feel the same way."

day4_accept_nurse_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_nurse_moment.text: *She stepped one pace closer. A faint fragrance brushed past my nose.*

day4_accept_nurse_close.name: Nurse
day4_accept_nurse_close.text: "At school, this stays between us. You know that, right?" *She whispered close to my ear.*

day4_accept_teacher.name: Teacher
day4_accept_teacher.text: "A student shouldn't be saying things like that... Me too, you idiot."

day4_accept_teacher_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_teacher_moment.text: *Her eyes were wavering. This side of her -- I must be the only one who gets to see it.*

day4_accept_teacher_close.name: Teacher
day4_accept_teacher_close.text: "...Brace yourself. You're not just my student anymore." *She let out a short laugh. Not a trace of her usual strictness remained.*

day4_after_confess.name: Me
day4_after_confess.text: *Beneath the sunset, two shadows merged into one. The happiest moment in the world.*

day4_wait_conflict.name: Me
day4_wait_conflict.text: *The words I wanted to say rose all the way up my throat -- and I swallowed them back down. Not yet. Not the right time.*

day4_wait_walk.name: Me
day4_wait_walk.text: *We walked the riverside path side by side. No words, but the silence wasn't uncomfortable.*

day4_wait_linger.name: Me
day4_wait_linger.text: *We'd have to part at the crosswalk ahead. Never knew a single step could be this hard to take.*

day4_wait_feelings.name: Me
day4_wait_feelings.text: *The words I swallowed earlier surged back up. 'I like you' -- three words pounding against the walls of my heart.*

day4_wait_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_wait_seoyeon.text: "I had fun too. Let's do this again." *Seoyeon smiled, but a flicker of reluctance showed in her eyes.*

day4_wait_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_wait_yuna.text: "...Wasn't bad. ...Let's do it again sometime." *Yuna turned her head slightly. Hiding her expression?*

day4_wait_dain.name: Dain
day4_wait_dain.text: "Of course it was fun!! Let's go out again!!" *Dain beamed, but I caught her biting her lip for just a second.*

day4_wait_nurse.name: Nurse
day4_wait_nurse.text: "I had a lovely time. Shall we meet again?" *Her smile seemed thinner than usual.*

day4_wait_teacher.name: Teacher
day4_wait_teacher.text: "Well, wasn't bad. Invite me again next time." *She smiled, but her steps as she turned away were slow.*

day4_wait_goodbye.name: Me
day4_wait_goodbye.text: *We said our goodbyes and I turned to walk away. I wanted to look back -- but held myself in check.*

day4_wait_regret.name: Me
day4_wait_regret.text: *I looked back anyway. They'd turned around too. The moment our eyes met -- we both jerked our heads away.*

day4_wait_home.name: Me
day4_wait_home.text: *Walking home. The words I couldn't say sat heavy in my chest. Next time... I'll definitely say it. Definitely.*

day4_wait_end.name: Me
day4_wait_end.text: *The unspoken words lingered in my heart.*
